entries.text: Oh, by the way, I'm glad you'll be my new roommate. My last one always wore ear plugs, I don't know why. Anyhow, feel free to leave anything you like here, I don't take up much space. Do you want the top bunk? I'll change if you want... you don't snore do you? Oh, it doesn't matter. See ya.
